title: Vauquelin three-storey mass-timber elementary school alternative-measure dossier
code_edition: Code de construction du Québec, Chapter I, Building, and National Building Code of Canada 2010 (modified), as stated in the report

facts.text: The project report describes a three-storey primary school in Longueuil using a mixed mass-timber and concrete structure, with a stated capacity of about 700 people.

The report identifies an NBC 2010 Article 3.2.2.24 noncombustible-construction issue for a three-storey Group A, Division 2 building, and describes partial gypsum encapsulation and fire modelling as proposed measures.

The attached RBQ response letter, file BAT-04627, describes a two-block school with one-hour fire separations and states conditions including a 568-person gymnasium cap, an 8 MW combustible-load limit, and exposed-wood area limits of 153 m² on level 2 and 122 m² on level 3.
The RBQ letter lists a signed professional alternative-solution proposal and drawing sheets A121, A131, A221, and A231 among documents forming part of the request.

limitations: Comparative source from outside Alberta; it cannot establish Alberta code performance or approval.
